title: The Wiener Wintner Theorem Along the Primes
summary: We prove the following Wiener-Wintner Theorem along the sequence of prime times, the first extension of the Wiener-Wintner Theorem to arithmetic sequences: for every probability space, $(X, ν),$ equipped with a measure-preserving transformation, $T : X \to X,$ and every $f \in L^p(X), 1 < p \leq \infty$, there exists a set of full probability, $X_f \subset X$ with $ν(X_f) = 1,$ so that for all $ω\in X_f$, \[ \frac{1}{N} \sum_{n \leq N} e^{ 2 πi p_n θ} f(T^{p_n} ω) \] converges for all $θ\in [0,1]$; above, $\{2 = p_1 < p_2 < \dots\}$ are an enumeration of the primes.
